newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Terra Mining falls 4 pct on merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Terra Mining falls 4 pct on merger talks.

text.p: Shares in Swedish miner Terra Mining fell over four percent on Tuesday on news that the company was in preliminary discussions over a possible merger.
The stock fell six crowns to 136 crowns by 0820 GMT when trade resumed following a suspension on Monday.

"There is quite a bit of uncertainty now around the stock," said one broker. "There have been rumours about a possible merger or takeover from time to time since Terra Mining was listed (in 1993) but noone knows what it going on."
The company on Tuesday announced it was in early discussions over a possible merger with one of several mining companies that showed an interest in the Swedish group this year.
